list.name: coin
list.label: Coin

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', day::timestamp) AS "time",
  coin_id,
  AVG(avg_price) AS value
FROM public_gold.vw_crypto_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
  AND (
    CASE WHEN '${coin:raw}' IN ('', '__all') THEN true
         ELSE coin_id IN (${coin:singlequote})
    END
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT avg_price AS value
FROM public_gold.vw_crypto_daily
WHERE coin_id = 'bitcoin'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT avg_price AS value
FROM public_gold.vw_crypto_daily
WHERE coin_id = 'ethereum'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT avg_price AS value
FROM public_gold.vw_crypto_daily
WHERE coin_id = 'solana'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT day, coin_id, vs_currency, avg_price, min_price, max_price
FROM public_gold.vw_crypto_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
  AND (
    CASE WHEN '${coin:raw}' IN ('', '__all') THEN true
         ELSE coin_id IN (${coin:singlequote})
    END
  )
ORDER BY day DESC, coin_id
LIMIT 50;
